## Finish checklist (docs/lynkomni-standards.md, section 2)
- [ ] Does what the master blueprint says, and nothing it forbids
- [ ] Works offline where required; never blocks an offline sale
- [ ] Screens are in their real-device emulator (light, dark, brand fonts, phone width), if any
- [ ] Provider work runs on a practice version, stays off, and is in the provider ledger
- [ ] Tests added or updated; all tests pass
- [ ] All GitHub checks green with no warnings
- [ ] Owner's actions list and later list up to date
- [ ] Version number and change-log line
- [ ] Owner told in plain words; master blueprint updated after the owner confirms
